title: [LOGGED OUT] "Gifts to friends" section shows gift ticket cards
reason: All answers match. Note: one scroll to the section was first done by script by mistake, then the page was re-scrolled with the scroll tool and the evidence taken from that.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded, title 'LUDUS - Merge Battle Arena PvP Web Shop', cookie banner visible

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown, Dismiss clicked, banner gone

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Gifts to friends" section.
steps.saw: Heading 'Gifts to friends' at top of viewport

steps.text: Is the ribbon text "Buy Tickets as gifts for your friends and fellow Clan members!" shown?
steps.saw: Ribbon with exactly that text under the heading

steps.text: Is at least one ticket card shown in the section (do not count them, the number changes over time)?
steps.saw: Ticket cards shown, e.g. Tournament Diamond Ticket, Tournament Golden Ticket, Clan War Golden Ticket

steps.text: Does each card show a "Gift" badge, a "Send to friends" line and a price button that starts with "USD"?
steps.saw: All cards in both rows show Gift badge, Send to friends line and a price button starting with USD (e.g. USD 21.60, USD 10.80, USD 16.20, USD 32.40)
